rulings.question: I digivolve a level 5 Digimon into this card. Can I place a red level 4 or lower Digimon card or level 7 Digimon card from my hand at the top of this card's digivolution cards?

rulings.answer: It becomes a level 3 Digimon. The digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.
rulings.question: I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) effect, trashing this card. What happens to the Digimon?

rulings.answer: The ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) effect trashes this card, and the Digimon becomes a level 3 Digimon. ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) can't be used to trash any more cards once the Digimon it's targeting becomes level 3, and the effect ends. Any digivolution cards placed below it remain, and their inherited effects can still be activated.
rulings.question: I use this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to place a level 3 Digimon card at the top of its digivolution cards. This Digimon is then targeted with a ＜De-Digivolve  2＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) effect. What happens?

rulings.answer: No. If you activate ＜Blitz＞ first, after activating any [When Attacking] or [When a Digimon attacks] effects, you activate the other [When Digivolving] effect before the reaction timing occurs.
rulings.question: This card has 2 [When Digivolving] effects. If ＜Blitz＞ resolves first, does the other [When Digivolving] effect resolve after the attack ends?

rulings.answer: No. If you activate ＜Blitz＞ first, after activating any [When Attacking] or [When one of your Digimon attacks] effects, you activate the other [When Digivolving] effect before the counter timing occurs.
rulings.question: This card has 2 [When Digivolving] effects. If ＜Blitz＞ resolves first, does the other [When Digivolving] effect resolve after the attack ends?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can. [BT5-017 ZeigGreymon]'s inherited effect allows you to attack an opponent's unsuspended Digimon.
rulings.question: I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to place [BT5-017 ZeigGreymon] at the top of its digivolution cards. If I then activate ＜Blitz＞ and attack, can I use [BT5-017 ZeigGreymon]'s inherited effect to attack an opponent's unsuspended Digimon?
When a Lv.5 Digimon digivolved into this Digimon, can I put a red Lv.4 or lower or Lv.7 Digimon card from my hand on top of the digivolved card?

rulings.answer: It will be a Lv.3 Digimon. The digivolution card that was under it will remain stacked, and the digivolution card can still activate the inherited effect.
rulings.question: With this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, I placed a Lv.3 Digimon card on top of the first Digivolution card. If this Digimon then receives the <De-Digivolve 1> effect and this card is trashed, what happens to the Digimon?

rulings.answer: ≪The effect of <De-Digivolve> causes this card to be trashed and become a Lv.3 Digimon. ≪Since <De-Digivolve 3> cannot be further trashed, <De-Digivolve> ends there. The digivolution card remains stacked and the inherited effect can be activated.
rulings.question: With this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect, I placed a Lv.3 Digimon card on top of the first Digivolution card. After that, when this Digimon receives the <De-Digivolve 2> effect, how is it handled?

rulings.answer: No. If you activate the [When Attacking] effect or the [When Digivolving] effect [When your Digimon attacks] first, the other [When Digivolved] effect will be activated before the Counter timing.
rulings.question: This card has two [When Digivolving] effects. If I resolve [When Attacking] first, do I resolve the other [When Digivolved] effect after finishing the attack?

rulings.answer: Yes, the digivolution card effect of "BT5-017 ZeigGreymon" can attack Digimon in active state.
rulings.question: With the [When Digivolving] effect of this card, I put "BT5-017 ZeigGreymon" on the top of the digivolution card. After that, if I activate the [Advance] effect and attack, can I attack the opponent's Digimon in the active state with the digivolution source effect of "BT5-017 ZeigGreymon"?
